proposal.observation: Round 1 was accepted: detecting binary_threshold 110, hough_threshold_oblique 22, maxLineGap_oblique 48 moved the proxy 0.603→0.634. correspondence_f1@15 rose 0.287→0.341 (+0.054), boundary_explained_edge@25 rose to 0.500, and chamfer_sym_px fell 80→67. sam_fill_rate stayed 0.698, ring_count_error stayed 0, and depth_nan_ratio stayed 0.142. On the after detected-lines image the positive-angle (red) track now covers almost every ring except the second column, where joint pixels at about y=1630 are still uncovered. The negative-angle (green) track near y=1480 is only present from about x=1375 rightward, although signal remains in some columns to the left. A few short spurious red ticks sit off those tracks. Prompts are still one propagated row at y≈1555, which is the continuous-family K-row snap, not a new failure. Stage-1 residual is still 10.20 cm with orient_agreement 0.999.
proposal.rule: When a sparse oblique relax raises correspondence and leaves fill, ring count, and depth NaN unchanged, take one smaller step in that same direction for the rings still missing a track. Do not open denoising, SAM, or unfolding, and do not copy the development joint overlays that lowered the proxy.
proposal.rationale: The accepted step recovered most of the positive-angle track but left the negative-angle track absent on the left rings and one positive-angle ring open. Those missing segments are why boundary_explained_edge is still 0.50 and chamfer is still 67 px. Correspondence is line-to-boundary F1, so the next change stays on the oblique detector that just moved it. From the accepted state, lower binary_threshold 110→104 so fainter left-side joint pixels pass THRESH_BINARY, lower hough_threshold_oblique 22→20 (bound floor) so the weak negative-angle votes and the second-ring gap can pass, and raise maxLineGap_oblique 48→56 so short fragments in those columns can join. These three values are the full detecting overlay on the family reference, so the accepted round-1 setting is not reverted. uniform_k_snap, vertical Hough, SAM, denoising, and unfolding stay at the reference: the propagated K row is the continuous snap design, and the development overlays that disabled it or moved those stages cut fill and correspondence.
